public.title: Range Right
public.description: Return an arithmetic range beginning at start with nonzero step, excluding end. For positive step continue while the current value is less than end; for negative step continue while it is greater than end. If the direction cannot reach end, return []. start/end are integers from -20 through 20; step is an integer from -10 through 10 excluding zero. There are at most 40 results. Return the generated range in reverse order. Reversing does not change which endpoint is excluded. Supported inputs are dense JSON values only: at most 100 total nodes, nesting depth at most 6, each string at most 80 UTF-16 code units, and integers from -1000 through 1000 unless narrower bounds are given. Unless the adapter explicitly defines path keys or another key format, object keys are nonempty ASCII letters without dots. All keys exclude prototype-related names. Inputs are valid; no validation is requested. Array order matters, object key order does not. Return a JSON value; no browser or third-party library is available. The complete serialized argument array is limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, counting JSON escaping. These whole-input limits also apply to descriptors, operations and nested values.
